schemas.afs_service_station:
CREATE TABLE `afs_service_station` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `code` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `org_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `org_code` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `org_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `remark` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `enabled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `revision` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `create_user` bigint NOT NULL,
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `update_user` bigint NOT NULL,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `manager_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `manager_mobile` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `hotline` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `service_items` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `daily_max_orders` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '5',
  `location_province` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `location_province_code` char(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `location_city` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `location_city_code` char(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `location_district` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `location_district_code` varchar(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `location_street` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `address` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `longitude` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `latitude` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `legal_representative` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `legal_representative_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `registered_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `registered_capital` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `bank_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `bank_account_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `bank_account_no` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `business_license_expires_at` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `organization_code_expires_at` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `tax_registration_expires_at` date DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_afs_service_station_code` (`code`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_station_status_name` (`enabled`,`name`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_station_org_id` (`org_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_station_daily_max_orders` CHECK ((`daily_max_orders` between 1 and 9999)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_station_enabled` CHECK ((`enabled` in (0,1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
schemas.afs_consumer_product_relation:

schemas.afs_order_assignment_history:

schemas.afs_complaint:
CREATE TABLE `afs_complaint` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `order_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `content_ciphertext` text NOT NULL,
  `actor_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `request_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `request_hash` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `revision` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `received_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `closed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `complaint_no` varchar(40) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STAFF',
  `consumer_account_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `consumer_instance_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `issue_category` varchar(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `contact_preference` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_complaint_request` (`order_id`,`request_id`),

  KEY `ix_complaint_status` (`status`,`received_at`),
  KEY `ix_complaint_consumer` (`consumer_account_id`,`received_at`,`id`),
  KEY `ix_complaint_consumer_order` (`consumer_account_id`,`order_id`,`status`),

  CONSTRAINT `ck_complaint_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'OPEN',_utf8mb4'PROCESSING',_utf8mb4'FOLLOW_UP',_utf8mb4'CLOSED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
schemas.afs_service_order:
CREATE TABLE `afs_service_order` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `order_no` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `order_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `source` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `customer_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `registration_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `contact_name_ciphertext` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `contact_name_masked` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `contact_mobile_digest` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `contact_mobile_ciphertext` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `contact_mobile_masked` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `province_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `province_code` char(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `city_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `city_code` char(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `district_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `district_code` varchar(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `street_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `address_ciphertext` varchar(2048) NOT NULL,
  `address_masked` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `longitude` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `latitude` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `expected_date` date NOT NULL,
  `expected_date_to` date NOT NULL,
  `expected_time_window` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `station_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `auto_dispatch_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MANUAL',
  `auto_dispatch_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_APPLICABLE',
  `auto_dispatch_failure_reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `auto_dispatch_attempts` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `remark` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `follow_up_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_FOLLOWED_UP',
  `satisfaction` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `client_request_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `revision` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `create_user` bigint NOT NULL,
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `update_user` bigint NOT NULL,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `intake_channel` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DEALER',
  `source_reference_ciphertext` varchar(1024) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `source_reference_masked` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `service_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ONSITE',
  `problem_description` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `fault_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `fault_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `fault_code` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `fault_summary` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `station_assignment_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `station_assignment_rule` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `station_override_reason` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `personnel_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `personnel_code` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `personnel_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `personnel_mobile` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `personnel_assignment_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MANUAL',
  `personnel_assignment_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_APPLICABLE',
  `personnel_assignment_failure_reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `personnel_assignment_attempts` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `dispatch_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `dispatch_reason` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `status_changed_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `exception_code` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `exception_reason` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `exception_escalated` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `exception_previous_status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `alternate_mobile1_ciphertext` varchar(1024) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `alternate_mobile1_masked` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `alternate_mobile2_ciphertext` varchar(1024) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `alternate_mobile2_masked` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `address_supplement_ciphertext` varchar(2048) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `address_supplement_masked` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `created_store_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '建单时创建门店',
  `created_store_code` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建门店编码快照',
  `created_store_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建门店名称快照',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_afs_service_order_no` (`order_no`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_afs_service_order_request` (`create_user`,`client_request_id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_registration` (`registration_id`,`create_time`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_status` (`status`,`expected_date`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_station` (`station_id`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_mobile` (`contact_mobile_digest`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_intake` (`intake_channel`,`create_time`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_personnel` (`personnel_id`,`status`,`expected_date`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_exception` (`exception_code`,`exception_escalated`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_fault` (`fault_id`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_order_region_code` (`province_code`,`city_code`,`district_code`),
  KEY `idx_afs_order_created_store` (`source`,`created_store_id`,`create_time`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_auto_dispatch_mode` CHECK ((`auto_dispatch_mode` in (_utf8mb4'MANUAL',_utf8mb4'SMART',_utf8mb4'AI'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_auto_dispatch_status` CHECK ((`auto_dispatch_status` in (_utf8mb4'NOT_APPLICABLE',_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'PROCESSING',_utf8mb4'SUCCESS',_utf8mb4'FAILED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_follow_up_status` CHECK ((`follow_up_status` in (_utf8mb4'NOT_FOLLOWED_UP',_utf8mb4'FOLLOWED_UP'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_intake_channel` CHECK ((`intake_channel` in (_utf8mb4'PHONE',_utf8mb4'WECHAT',_utf8mb4'CONSUMER',_utf8mb4'DEALER',_utf8mb4'API'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_personnel_assignment_mode` CHECK ((`personnel_assignment_mode` in (_utf8mb4'MANUAL',_utf8mb4'SMART',_utf8mb4'AI'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_personnel_assignment_status` CHECK ((`personnel_assignment_status` in (_utf8mb4'NOT_APPLICABLE',_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'PROCESSING',_utf8mb4'SUCCESS',_utf8mb4'FAILED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_satisfaction` CHECK ((`satisfaction` in (_utf8mb4'',_utf8mb4'SATISFIED',_utf8mb4'UNSATISFIED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_service_mode` CHECK ((`service_mode` in (_utf8mb4'REMOTE',_utf8mb4'ONSITE'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_source` CHECK ((`source` in (_utf8mb4'DEALER',_utf8mb4'CUSTOMER_SERVICE',_utf8mb4'CONSUMER',_utf8mb4'API'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_order_type` CHECK ((`order_type` in (_utf8mb4'INSTALLATION',_utf8mb4'REPAIR',_utf8mb4'CLEANING',_utf8mb4'GUIDANCE')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
schemas.afs_service_quality_daily:
CREATE TABLE `afs_service_quality_daily` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `snapshot_date` date NOT NULL,
  `scope_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `scope_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `scope_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `service_count` int NOT NULL,
  `on_time_count` int NOT NULL,
  `first_time_resolved_count` int NOT NULL,
  `rated_count` int NOT NULL,
  `rating_total` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `complaint_count` int NOT NULL,
  `generated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_afs_service_quality_daily_scope` (`snapshot_date`,`scope_type`,`scope_id`),
  KEY `idx_afs_service_quality_daily_date` (`snapshot_date`,`scope_type`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_quality_daily_counts` CHECK (((`service_count` >= 0) and (`on_time_count` between 0 and `service_count`) and (`first_time_resolved_count` between 0 and `service_count`) and (`rated_count` between 0 and `service_count`) and (`rating_total` >= 0) and (`complaint_count` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_afs_service_quality_daily_scope` CHECK ((`scope_type` in (_utf8mb4'PERSONNEL',_utf8mb4'STATION',_utf8mb4'AREA')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
schemas.afs_order_exception_event:

schemas.afs_order_communication:
